newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil exports $903 million in fourth week of Nov.
newsitem.headline: Brazil exports $903 million in fourth week of Nov.

text.p: Brazil exported $903 million in the fourth week of November, with average daily exports of $180.6 million, a spokeswoman for the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said.
She said total exports so far for November were $2.944 billion with a daily average of $196.3 million.
In the third week of the month, exports were $845 million with a daily average of $211.3 million.

Brazil posted a $1.308 billion trade gap in October, its largest on record. Private economists and the government have forecast a 1996 trade gap of as high as $5 billion. Last year's deficit was $3.15 billion.
